changes: Fixed: critical XP bug — winning a Hold'em pot was crediting your real balance immediately but never adding it back to your table stack, making a genuine win look like a loss at the seat
Fixed: long player names overlapping/cutting off in the circular seat layout
Fixed: all 5 board cards now fit on one row instead of wrapping
New: showdown now shows the winning hand type (Pair, Three of a Kind, etc.)
New: live countdown shown for the action timer, now 30s (was 90s)
Changed: flop/turn/river deal with a slower, more deliberate pace
Fixed: Casino Pot rules were genuinely missing from the deployed rules file, causing the 401 read errors
